errors.configCorrupt: Your settings file could not be read. It was moved to {{path}} and Orchard started with default settings.

sidebar.removeRepoConfirm: Remove {{repo}} from Orchard? Files and worktrees on disk are kept.

worktree.lazygitInstallMac: Orchard could not run “{{command}}”. Install lazygit with “brew install lazygit”, then try again.
worktree.lazygitInstallLinux: Orchard could not run “{{command}}”. On Debian 13 or Ubuntu 25.04 and later, install it with “sudo apt install lazygit”; on other distributions, follow the install guide. Then try again.

newWorktree.title: New worktree in {{repo}}
newWorktree.baseHint: Used only when the branch does not exist yet.
newWorktree.agentHint: Runs in the worktree. Leave empty for a plain shell.

remove.title: Remove worktree
remove.body: Remove worktree {{branch}} at {{path}}? Its terminals will be stopped.
remove.dirty_one: It has {{count}} uncommitted change. Tick "force" to discard it.
remove.dirty_other: It has {{count}} uncommitted changes. Tick "force" to discard them.
remove.deleteBranch: Also delete local branch {{branch}} (the remote branch is never deleted)

settings.title: Settings
settings.agentCommandHint: For example claude, codex or opencode.
settings.editorCommandHint: Receives the worktree path, for example code or cursor.
settings.worktreeRootHint: Empty: <repo>.worktrees next to the repository. Otherwise <folder>/<repo>/<branch>.
settings.autoUpdateHint: Checks GitHub Releases for new versions. On macOS they install in the background and apply the next time Orchard starts. On Linux, a button in the sidebar opens the release page.

update.availableHintLinux: Opens the release page. Install the new .deb with: sudo apt install ./orchard_amd64.deb
update.availableHintMac: Opens the release page. Orchard cannot replace itself in its folder; update with: brew upgrade --cask --greedy orchard
update.openFailed: Could not open the release page

empty.welcomeBody: Add a git repository, then create a worktree for each task. Each one gets its own agent terminal and lazygit.
empty.pickBody: Select a worktree in the sidebar or press {{shortcut}} to create one.
